sections.title: Wardrobe map (§21, §14A) — per story day
sections.md:
| Day | When (the song) | N | C1 Loretta | C2 Daughter |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| N-D0 | "Eleven years of knee pain" — the old way (C-08a) | plum knit top, long grey skirt, pink terry slippers | — | — |
| N-D1 / D1b / D1c | "Six weeks ago" — the problem days | faded blue floral knee-length house dress, grey cardigan, pink terry slippers; bare right knee (brace beats) · D1b clinic: the same dress | — | — |
| N-D2 | the wedding, June (evening) | lavender chiffon dress to mid-calf, pearl studs, low silver heels | royal-blue satin dress to the knee, white slip-on sneakers for dancing (strap hidden under the hem) | — |
| N-D3a / N-D3 | Loretta's visit — arrival, then the next morning, the reveal and the first stairs | rose-pink short-sleeve blouse, denim skirt above the knee (bare right knee for the ice pack and the strap, FP13), tan house slippers | **sheet outfit**: teal three-quarter-sleeve blouse, **khaki trousers** (the lyric: "She pulled up her pant leg" — rolled above the knee on R-03b; R-04a frames the bare knee with the rolled hem out of frame — see F14), white canvas slip-ons | — |
| N-D4 | "Last Sunday" — hook stairs and the church steps | emerald-green church dress to mid-calf, low black pumps; strap **hidden** under the hem; wide-brim hat at church only | — | **sheet outfit**: olive sweatshirt, black denim shorts, white trainers (hook) |
| N-D5 | "every day for six weeks" — bedroom, table, box, the offer | pale-yellow cotton nightgown to the knee (PR-05a, C-01a) → navy trousers pulled over (PR-05b); the kitchen beats hands-only; C-06a on the sofa in the **sheet outfit** (mustard top, denim skirt) | — | — |
| N-D6 | "Yesterday" — the store walk, the porch | coral windbreaker over a white T-shirt, light-blue straight jeans (strap hidden), white walking sneakers, canvas tote | — | — |
| N-D7 | "She coming Sunday" — the sister's visit | **sheet outfit** (mustard top, denim skirt) at the top of the stairs | — | the sister (one-off, 68): a navy Sunday dress, the ribboned box |
| G-1…G-8 | one-off generic days | — | — | montage wearers, the doctor, the husband, the niece, the surgeon's patient: shorts or a bare knee on every worn beat (FP13) |

**§14A novelty:** no two of N's days share a top or a dress; the church day and the hook are the same Sunday (one outfit). **Sheets are the body reference** (bare knees); the strap is always on the **right** knee.

sections.title: Story-day map (§14A)
sections.md:
| Day | Acts | Beats |
|---|---|---|
| N-D0 | Act 8 (memory) | C-08a |
| N-D1 (+ D1b clinic, D1c kitchen) | Act 1, Act 4 callbacks | P-01a–P-05b, M-01a, M-04a |
| N-D2 | Act 2 | T-01a–T-04b |
| N-D3a → N-D3 | Act 3, M-06a, C-08b | R-01a–R-07c, M-06a, C-08b |
| N-D4 | Hook, Act 7 | HK-01a–HK-03a, C-02a/b |
| N-D5 | Acts 5, 7, 8 | PR-05a–PR-06b, C-01a, C-04b–C-07a, C-09a |
| N-D6 | Acts 6, 7 | L-01a–L-03b, C-03a |
| N-D7 | Act 8 | C-09b/c |

Two exceptions: Act 7 spans N-D4 (church), N-D5 (bedroom, kitchen) and N-D6 (porch) — a proof act drawing on three days; Act 8 reaches back to N-D0 for one beat (the old way) and forward to N-D7 (the sister).
